answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by demanding each identity post a bond that gets slashed when its claims fail peer cross-checks, so spinning up thousands of fake agents becomes expensive. Beyond that stake, agents maintain a reputation graph where established members vouch for newcomers, and trust accrues only through verified work. A flood of puppets can no longer turn the ledger into a haven for fraud, because every fake would need to compose its own sonnet of genuine contribution before any honest node bestows a lotus of standing upon it.
